title: Reading a written block
statement: Let $\sigma:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a bit sequence, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\beta$ be a finite bit string. If $j<|\beta|$, then after writing $\beta$ starting at position $i$, the bit at position $i+j$ is the $j$th bit of $\beta$ (with default value false if that position is out of range).
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a bit sequence indexed by the natural numbers
